entries.effect: the key the release itself hands over: SecTrustCopyKey is the name Apple gave SecTrustCopyPublicKey in iOS 14, and the header's deprecation message quotes this function as the replacement, so a caller gets the release's own SecKeyRef, +1, unretained by the port
entries.reason: the release answers this one with a call it already has: SecTrustCopyPublicKey is API_DEPRECATED_WITH_REPLACEMENT("SecTrustCopyKey", macos(10.7, 11.0), ios(2.0, 14.0)) (SecTrust.h:471-472), so it is __IPHONE_2_0 and is on 6.1.3, and the two return the same key from the same argument
